Content & licence policy

Which games may appear on Toolstack Lab Games, and what we show you about each one.

What we list

Today every game on this site is made by Toolstack Lab: our own code, art and sound. If we ever list a game by someone else, it must meet both of these rules:

  • Its licence clearly allows other sites to embed it and to use it commercially, or it is in the public domain.
  • Its maker and the original source are named on its game page.

What we never list

  • Copies or ports of well-known games, characters or brands we do not have rights to. Borrowing a mechanic is fine; copying levels, art or names is not.
  • Games that need an account or collect personal data just to play.
  • Store art or screenshots taken from other sites. Every picture here is a frame from the game itself or art we made.

How we vet games

A game is only published once its licence and source are on record. Both are shown on every game page and in the list on this page. A game without them cannot be published.

Your privacy

This site sets no cookies and loads no ad, analytics or other third-party scripts or fonts. Game progress is saved in your own browser and never leaves your device.

Questions or a problem?

If you think a game here breaks this policy, tell us through gettoolstacklab.com and we will review it.
